chunks: 46 – Al-Hasan ibn Abi Qutada, Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Hafsa ibn Ubayd ibn Humayd, the client of al-Sa'ib ibn Malik al-Ash'ari, known by the kunya of Abu Muhammad.
The "Poems of Amr ibn Ma'di Karib and his reports" has arrived to me, (it is) his production.
ai.seo_question: Who is Al-Hasan ibn Abi Qutada and what work is he associated with in Shia biographical sources?
ai.summary: This entry from Kitab al-Du'afa identifies Al-Hasan ibn Abi Qutada as a narrator known for compiling the poetry and reports of the pre-Islamic poet Amr ibn Ma'di Karib. It serves as a biographical note establishing his authorship or compilation of this specific work.
